Survey method, app evidence, and limitations
Self-serve online survey with interview-style prompts; not synchronous interviews
Up to 17 steps with rider and driver branches
Four open-text or voice prompts on the difficulty path; the live UI labels them optional
Problem, location, action, delay, what helped, and recurrence
Consent-gated UI for anonymous quote use; consent was not stored as a separate backend field
Timestamped submissions to Google Apps Script and Google Sheets
Contact field and raw payload excluded from this workbook
R032 removed as a confirmed duplicate of R031: identical text, city, and 9-second interval
State clearly; do not call survey records interviews
Do not generalize to Hyderabad prevalence
4 of 62 responses; no driver-wide product conclusion
29 of 62 responses; not a small side sample
No real-time probing of vague or contradictory answers
Qualitative depth varies; only a subset completed detailed narratives
Earlier records have less qualitative detail
Use the consent-screen screenshot as app evidence, not row-level consent proof
No reliable Hyderabad trip-volume or issue-rate denominator found
